info.name: This method allows cached image(s) given a given image URL or folder to be refreshed.

items.docs:
This method delegates to marvel-admin's marveltool-api (running in tomcat) to refresh cached image(s) given image URL or folder.
For urlType 'folder', only top-level images will be refreshed, images on sub-folder(s) remains.
